achievements: Provides an explicit single-mode variational comparison and exact BCC Voronoi-cell geometry.
assumptions: BCC mode set fixed before minimization

contradictions.statement: Later Math194/Math383 re-validation and Math400 invalidate promotion from the single-mode cone to global BCC selection.

legacy_conclusion: The note claimed BCC uniqueness within its restricted mode cone and connected the real-space BCC Voronoi cell to a truncated octahedron.
legacy_purpose: Derive BCC selection inside a scalar single-mode Landau-Brazovskii reduction and identify its Voronoi cell.
negative_findings: The calculation does not establish global selection over the current admissible class or a below-empty-reference sign.
next_actions: Use only as a geometry/method input in T-055 and compare every candidate against the same empty/disordered reference.
no_overclaim: This record does not establish BCC as the physical vacuum, a global minimum, or the origin of spacetime.
title: Single-mode BCC uniqueness lineage
tsv2_ceiling: T5 within the declared single-mode cone only
